title: Use a workflow of Concept → Custom GPT → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0…
content: Use a workflow of Concept → Custom GPT → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 prompt to turn an idea into a Seedance-ready video prompt.
